subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and own a bundled Claude app-server runtime, including its executable package, security boundary, persistent state, configuration, and long-term support contract?
rationale: Accepting this PR would establish a new provider-managed runtime architecture and commit the repository to package, credential, state, migration, compatibility, and security ownership; code correctness alone cannot decide that commitment.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Keep Claude-specific runtime, commands, and state external and land only independently justified generic Plugin SDK gaps through focused PRs.

options.title: Sponsor bundled runtime
options.body: OpenClaw adopts and republishes the executable, redesigns state around SQLite and doctor, and owns the auth, config, security, and compatibility contract.

options.title: Use existing Claude paths
options.body: Decline the new runtime and address concrete gaps in the Anthropic provider, Claude CLI, attach, and ACPX flows.

recommendation.title: External plugin first
recommendation.body: Keep Claude-specific runtime, commands, and state external and land only independently justified generic Plugin SDK gaps through focused PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent work owns the current generic harness-auth and SQLite app-server binding architecture that this decision would extend or bypass.
